summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a change to its ADS ratio from one ADS representing two ordinary shares to one ADS representing twenty ordinary shares, effective on or about October 23, 2026. For ADS holders this is equivalent to a one-for-ten reverse ADS split; certificated holders must surrender ADSs to Citibank, N.A. as depositary for mandatory cancellation, while DRS and DTC holders are exchanged automatically. No fractional new ADSs will be issued; fractions are aggregated and sold with net proceeds distributed. Ordinary shares are unaffected, and the NYSE symbol LU is unchanged.
